fusions.name: Spadeful Scatter
fusions.desc: Flings 3 clods of earth at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge of the Blade
fusions.desc: A downward chop with the spade's edge that deals 24 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Thrown-Up Berm
fusions.desc: Throws up a bank of earth 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Spadework
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
